risk_note: RV2 (orders/**). Order source backfill (BR-ATTR-15) inside the attribution pipeline transaction, only when this sync sets user_id from null: exact (own link code, hit-and-stop without reading later ports) → product → shop → none; product / shop require the click's pid_scene to equal the slot written by this update (fallback slot unrestricted; an unknown slot scene does not match across scenes, D10-60); 360-hour window; port failures roll back. Source ports are not injected in production yet (the four columns stay NULL); first-import shop matching is a tracked gap (UnionOrder has no shop_id) fixed by B1-08p before any wiring (orchestrator ruling D10-64 B).
